# ...and keeps some of the money back
#
# The same again, except 1,000.00 USD stays in the account. Both kinds of
# gain are on the page at once: 12.56 realized on what left, 7.30
# unrealized on what is still held.
# 
# Drawn at another price the realized figure does not move and the
# unrealized one does, which is why they cannot share a line.
#

#
#     gnucash-plaintext import --new /tmp/check.gnucash \
#         examples/multi-currency/some_of_the_dollars_kept_back.txt
#     gnucash-plaintext balance-sheet /tmp/check.gnucash --as-of 2026-12-31
#
# The statement that ledger produces is at the end of this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# What `balance-sheet --as-of 2026-12-31` prints for the book above.
#
# Commented, every line of it. A statement opens with a dated
# directive — `2026-12-31 balance-sheet` — and the import reads a
# line at column 0 as one, so a file carrying both would refuse to
# import and this example would not do the one thing it is for.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# 2026-12-31 balance-sheet
# 	# An account line is that account's own balance — never its children's.
# 	# A section total, and any figure no account holds, is a key.
# 	# share_price: and value: under an account line are what this report
# 	# valued the holding at on this date, not the rate a split happened at.
# 	#
# 	# A gain already taken is stated apart from one the book has yet to
# 	# take, and only the unrealized total reaches total_equity.
# 	# gnucash_balancing_amount is GnuCash's own figure, carried across so
# 	# the two can be read against each other, and added into nothing.
# 	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 	Assets:Bank 2384.78 CAD
# 	Assets:Bank:USD 1000.00 USD
# 		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 		share_price: "1.3865"
# 		value: "1386.50"
# 	total_assets: 3771.28 CAD
# 	total_liabilities: 0.00 CAD
# 	retained_earnings: 3778.58 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_assets_fx:
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				type: asset
# 				share_price: 1.3865 # current price of commodity in balance sheet currency
# 				cost_bases:
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: 92d8e34e303c498c99403191d0ecc2e9
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 1000.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1 # USD in USD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 189557/136000 # CAD per USD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 189557/136000 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 1393.80 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 1386.50 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -7.30 # value - cost_value
# 				cost_basis_balance: 1000.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_basis_balance
# 				cost_value: 1393.80 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_value
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 52e6b9b8f73c418c901742a52c0290ae
# 						name: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: 70ac6f7b1a4f457a8929597e45e54278
# 						name: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						balance: 1000.00
# 				balance_value: 1000.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				value: 1386.50 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 				unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -7.30 # value - cost_value
# 		cost_value: 1393.80 # sum of each commodity's cost_value
# 		value: 1386.50 # sum of each commodity's value
# 		unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -7.30 # value - cost_value
# 	unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx: 0.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_fx: -7.30 CAD # unrealized_gains_assets_fx + unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx
# 	realized_gains_fx:
# 		realized_gains_fx: -12.56
# 		splits:
# 			split:
# 				date: 2026-08-17
# 				account: "Income:FX Gain"
# 				amount: -12.56
# 	realized_gains_other: 0.00 CAD
# 	total_realized_gains: -12.56 CAD # realized_gains_fx + realized_gains_other
# 	unrealized_gains_other: # sum of unrealized_gains_other of all securities and funds
# 		securities: # there is no security or fund
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each security's value
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each security's cost_value
# 		unrealized_gains_other: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	total_unrealized_gains: -7.30 CAD # unrealized_gains_fx + unrealized_gains_other
# 	gnucash_balancing_amount: # the commodities GnuCash's own figure is summed from
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 7c8eaeda93c44c8bbc3d001cb3904b2a
# 						account: "Assets:Bank"
# 						value: 2384.78
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 43fe581185734a8d884159c4df137ae4
# 						account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						value: -2397.34
# 				sum_value: -12.56 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 3c52a98b574840b2a6ff23a4783e4347
# 						name: "Assets"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: 90d3ce409ab54908be1afbd2958ed4cc
# 						name: "Assets:Bank"
# 						balance: 2384.78
# 				balance_value: 2384.78 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 2397.34 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 2397.34 # 2397.34 CAD at 1 CAD per CAD
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 39c3229a6ba74d4a92c04488643819b0
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						value: -2720.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 92d8e34e303c498c99403191d0ecc2e9
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						value: 2720.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: a1a6a72350a94e6b89f9a85ec57c8b74
# 						account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						value: 2720.00
# 				sum_value: 2720.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 52e6b9b8f73c418c901742a52c0290ae
# 						name: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"

# 				gains_before_conversion: -1720.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: -2384.78 # -1720.00 USD at 1.3865 CAD per USD
# 		gnucash_balancing_amount: 12.56 # sum of balance_sheet_value of all commodities
# 	total_equity: 3771.28 CAD
